name: woofx3
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Chat commands, alerts, counters, timers, queues, schedules, forms, databases and scene widgets, ready to use.

resources.name: Counter
resources.description: A number your steps change and overlays and chat can show: deaths, wins, hugs given. Give it goals and it announces reaching them.

schema.label: Keeps its value
schema.description: A per-stream counter goes back to its starting value when the stream ends; a forever counter keeps counting. Changing this applies the next time the counter changes.

schema.label: Starts at
schema.description: Its value before anything changes it, and what Reset goes back to.

schema.label: Counts by
schema.description: How much Increment adds and Decrement takes away.

schema.label: Goals
schema.description: Numbers to announce reaching, each with an optional name. Leave it empty and the counter just counts.

schema.label: Announce every time
schema.description: Announce a goal again each time it is reached after dropping below it. Off, only the first time announces.

resources.name: Timer
resources.description: A countdown your steps start, pause and add time to, and overlays and chat can show: break timers, subathons, giveaways.

schema.label: Keeps its value
schema.description: A per-stream timer goes back to its full time, stopped, when the stream ends; a forever timer keeps its value. Changing this applies the next time the timer changes.

schema.label: Runs for
schema.description: How long it counts down from, and what Reset goes back to.

resources.name: Queue
resources.description: A line of entries your steps add to and take from, and overlays and chat can show: viewer games, song requests.

schema.label: Keeps its value
schema.description: A per-stream queue empties when the stream ends; a forever queue keeps its entries. Changing this applies the next time the queue changes.

schema.label: Holds up to
schema.description: How many entries fit before Add refuses more. 0 allows the most a queue can hold, 1000.

schema.label: Allow duplicates
schema.description: Let the same entry be in line more than once. Off, adding an entry already in line leaves it where it is.

schema.label: Approve into
schema.description: Makes this a review queue: each entry gets an Approve button that moves it to this other queue. Leave it empty for a normal queue.

resources.name: Schedule
resources.description: Runs on a repeating timer once started, such as a chat message every 15 minutes.

schema.label: Keeps running
schema.description: A per-stream schedule stops when the stream ends and waits to be started again. Changing this applies the next time the schedule changes.

schema.label: Runs every
schema.description: How long it waits between runs, up to four weeks. Changing this applies within a minute to a schedule that is running.

schema.label: Run while offline
schema.description: Off, it only runs while you are live and skips its runs the rest of the time. On, it also runs when you are not streaming.

resources.name: Form
resources.description: Questions viewers answer on your public page. Each submission can save to a database, post to chat or anything else you set up.

schema.label: Title
schema.description: Shown above the questions. Leave it empty for no title.

schema.label: Button text
schema.description: What the send button says.

resources.name: Database
resources.description: A table you keep: one row per entry, one column per detail. Form answers, games you played, giveaway entrants. Columns you mark can show on your public page.

functions.name: End a timer that has run out
Run a schedule that came due
Check for schedules that came due

actions.name: Run module function
actions.description: Run one of a module's functions.

actions.name: Run command
actions.description: Run a chat command's steps as if someone typed it. The command must exist and be turned on.

schema.label: Command
schema.description: The command's name, with or without the !.

fields.description: False when the command's own conditions stopped the run.

actions.name: Send chat message
actions.description: Send a message to chat: where it started, every platform, or one you choose.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: Plain text. Twitch allows up to 500 characters.

schema.label: Platform
schema.hint: Where it was triggered replies in the chat it came from. With no chat behind it, like a timer, it goes to every platform.
schema.description: Which chat to send to. The step fails when a platform it sends to is turned off, not connected or refuses the message.

actions.name: Send announcement
actions.description: Post a highlighted announcement in chat. The step fails on a platform without announcements.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: Plain text. Twitch allows up to 500 characters.

schema.label: Platform
schema.hint: Where it was triggered uses the chat the trigger came from. With no chat behind it, such as a timer, it goes to every platform.
schema.description: Which chat to send to. The step fails when a platform it sends to is turned off, not connected or refuses the message.

schema.label: Twitch color
schema.description: The color of the announcement bar on Twitch.

actions.name: Pin message
actions.description: Post a message in chat and pin it. The step fails on a platform that can't pin.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: Plain text. Twitch allows up to 500 characters.

schema.label: Platform
schema.hint: Where it was triggered uses the chat the trigger came from. With no chat behind it, such as a timer, it goes to every platform.
schema.description: Which chat to send to. The step fails when a platform it sends to is turned off, not connected or refuses the message.

schema.label: Pin for (seconds)
schema.description: How long the message stays pinned, from 30 to 1200 seconds. Leave empty to use the platform's own default.

actions.name: Look up a viewer
actions.description: Look up a user on a streaming platform: who they are, their avatar and whether they are live. Every field is available to later steps. Each platform's own module provides the lookup.

schema.label: User
schema.description: The user to look up. A leading @ and extra spaces are removed.
schema.hint: Can use details from the trigger, such as what the chatter typed.

schema.label: Platform
schema.description: Which platform to look the user up on.

fields.description: The platform the user was looked up on.
The user's id on that platform.
The username that was looked up.
The name as the user spells it.
Their avatar.
Whether they are streaming right now.

actions.name: Alert
actions.description: Play an alert on stream, using the widgets you arranged in it.
actions.sentence: Play an alert on the {target} alert widget

schema.label: Alert widget
schema.description: Plays on every alert widget with this name. Give alert widgets on several scenes the same name to show the same alerts on each.

schema.label: Alert
schema.description: What the alert shows. It lasts as long as its longest widget.

actions.name: Set widget visibility
actions.description: Show or hide a widget on a scene. It stays that way until changed again.

schema.label: Widget
schema.description: The widget on the chosen scene. A widget placed twice is two choices, one per placement.

schema.label: Visible
schema.description: On shows the widget, off hides it. A hidden widget keeps running, so it shows again instantly and as it was.

actions.name: Add a row
actions.description: Add a row to a database. With an Only once per value, the same event never adds a second row.

schema.label: Database
schema.description: Which database to use.

schema.label: Values
schema.description: What to put in each column. Columns left empty stay empty.

schema.label: Only once per
schema.description: Optional. A value that stays the same for the same event, such as a submission ID. A row already added with it is not added again.

fields.description: The database.
The row added, or the row already added with the same key. Empty when the database is full.
Whether a new row was added.
Why not: duplicate or full. Empty when it was added.

actions.name: Change a row
actions.description: Change some columns of one row in a database. Columns you leave out keep their value; an empty value clears a column.

schema.label: Database
schema.description: Which database to use.

schema.label: Row
schema.description: The row to change, such as one from an earlier Read a row or Add a row step.

schema.label: Values
schema.description: The new value of each column to change.

fields.description: The database.
The row.
Whether the row was changed.
Why not: missing when there is no such row. Empty when it was changed.

actions.name: Read a row
actions.description: Find one row of a database, by its row ID or by a value in one column, so later steps can use it.

schema.label: Database
schema.description: Which database to use.

schema.label: Find by
schema.description: The column to look in. Leave it empty to find the row by its row ID.

schema.label: Value
schema.description: What to look for. When several rows hold it, the oldest is read.

fields.description: The database.
Whether a row was found.
The row found. Empty when none was.
When the row was added.
The row's column values, such as values.game.

widgets.name: Alert

settingsSchema.label: Counter at last frame
settingsSchema.description: With a counter: the value that shows the animation's last frame. Set it below the first-frame value to run the animation backwards as the counter rises.

deadlines.description: Ends a running timer the moment it reaches zero and lets everything know it ended.
Runs a schedule the moment it comes due and sets up the next run.

backgroundTasks.description: When the module loads and once a minute after, ends every timer that has run out and sets up the end of the others.
When the module loads and once a minute after, sets up the next run of every running schedule and applies changed intervals.
